tagline: Fostering an ecosystem where new forms of value exchange enabled by crypto assets and blockchain can flourish.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver as it measures the base of verified active users, fundamental to trading volume growth and recurring revenues within the crypto ecosystem. It is a key indicator of adoption and trust in a regulated market such as Japan.

kpis.name: Verified Accounts
kpis.explanation: Total number of user accounts that have completed KYC verification, less closed accounts.
kpis.description: Verified accounts are a key indicator of user penetration and regulatory compliance. Up 13% year-on-year, they reflect continued adoption despite asset volatility.
kpis.signal: Solid user base growth despite market volatility.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenues for the fiscal year, including transaction fees and other operating revenues.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased 71% year-on-year (from 224.049 billion yen in FY2024 to 383.330 billion yen in FY2025), driven by rising crypto-asset prices and trading volumes.
kpis.signal: Major growth driven by Bitcoin price appreciation and higher trading volumes.

kpis.name: Marketplace Trading Volume
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions executed on the Marketplace platform during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Marketplace trading volume increased 491% in FY2025 (fiscal year ended March 31, 2025), reflecting Bitcoin's new all-time high in January 2025 and heightened investor interest.
kpis.signal: Exceptional growth due to crypto market rebound and Bitcoin rally.

kpis.name: Customer Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of cryptocurrencies and fiat currencies held on behalf of customers (calculated under J-GAAP).
kpis.description: Customer assets totaled 859 billion yen as of March 31, 2025, up 15% from the prior year, reflecting higher crypto-asset prices.
kpis.signal: Increase driven by rising crypto-asset prices, particularly Bitcoin and XRP.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before amortization, depreciation, and financing costs.
kpis.description: EBITDA for FY2025 was a loss of 12.603 billion yen, primarily due to exceptional expenses related to the business combination and IPO. Adjusted EBITDA was positive at 5.718 billion yen.
kpis.signal: EBITDA loss due to exceptional charges related to the Business Combination and Nasdaq listing.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: EBITDA adjusted to exclude exceptional charges related to the Business Combination and Nasdaq listing.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for FY2025 reached 5.718 billion yen, up 52% from 3.773 billion yen in FY2024, reflecting underlying operational growth.
kpis.signal: Improved operational profitability after adjusting for exceptional charges.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit or loss after all expenses, amortization, and taxes.
kpis.description: Net loss for FY2025 was 14.350 billion yen, compared to net profit of 1.967 billion yen in FY2024. The loss is primarily attributable to exceptional expenses and charges related to the Business Combination.
kpis.signal: Net loss due to exceptional charges related to the Business Combination and IPO.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 112.27 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Verified Accounts
kpis.explanation: Total number of user accounts that have completed KYC verification, less closed accounts.
kpis.description: Verified accounts are a key indicator of adoption and trust in a regulated market such as Japan.
kpis.signal: Sustained user base growth in Japan.

risks.title: Dependence on crypto-asset volumes and prices
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language ("adversely affected", "prolonged volatility"), stable trend, high weight as 99.6% of revenues depend on platform transactions.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and platform security
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a major risk with concrete examples (DMM Bitcoin hack, Bybit attacks, North Korean attacks), alarming language ("sophisticated attacks", "irretrievable loss"), increasing trend, critical category for crypto platforms.

risks.title: Intense competition in the Japanese market
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the text ("highly competitive industry"), moderate but repeated language, stable trend, high weight due to risk of market share loss and innovation pressure.

risks.title: Dependence on Japanese retail customers
risks.score_rationale: Key position in the document ("nearly all of the trading volume"), strong language, stable trend, high weight due to lack of geographic or demographic diversification.

risks.title: Risks related to the NFT market
risks.score_rationale: Specific mention in the 10-K, cautious but concerned language ("legal, regulatory, and other risks"), stable trend, growing weight with NFT development.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party providers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in risks ("third-party service providers"), moderate language, stable trend, medium weight as tied to continuity of critical services.

risks.title: International expansion and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Important position in the text, strong language ("adverse to the Company", "violations of international sanctions"), increasing trend, high weight in case of expansion.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and growth management
risks.score_rationale: Detailed mention with example (Next Finance), concerned language ("disrupt our business", "dilution"), stable trend, high weight as a core strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or AI tools in Coincheck's recent communications. The company focuses on crypto infrastructure, security, and institutional expansion through acquisitions.
evidence: No reference to AI in 10-K and 6-K filings
No AI-related products or features mentioned
